# Metrics

Measured on 2026-08-07 from a clean working tree, at the single commit in this snapshot.
Reproduce with `pnpm metrics`. Counts come from `git ls-files`, so nothing gitignored can be
counted. Line counts are physical lines, blanks and comments included.

**One row is hand-corrected, dated 2026-08-18.** The "Prose documentation" row below was
recounted directly against this repository's markdown files, applying the same classifier
`scripts/portfolio-metrics.mjs` uses (any tracked `.md` file, since none matches an earlier,
more specific bucket). The recount found 50 files and 18,976 lines, against the 45 and 17,987
this file reported from the 2026-08-07 run. Five files were added afterward:
`docs/goal-portfolio-public/LEDGER.md`, `docs/qa/prod-e2e-bug-report-2026-05-06.md`, and, in
the most recent portfolio-standard pass, `portfolio/README.md`, `portfolio/ENGINEERING-LOG.md`,
and `portfolio/SECURITY.md`. Every other number in this file is untouched and still reflects
the 2026-08-07 measurement: regenerating the whole file would overwrite that clean run with a
dirty-tree one, the same reasoning the ledger's PORT-02 correction applied to the README.
